result.summary: The page appears visually complete and functional as a food delivery app home screen. No critical or major broken elements are visible. One minor issue is identified regarding the cut-off content in the restaurant list.

issues.description: The last visible restaurant card (pizza image) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, indicating there is more content below that requires scrolling. While this is normal for a scrollable list, the cut-off is abrupt without a visual cue like a fade or shadow to indicate more content.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a subtle gradient fade at the bottom of the viewport to hint that there is more content to scroll down to.
